text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to renovation work at Nakayama 
Racecourse, this year's Satsuki Sho will 
be held at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —The earth is shaking.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The vibrations traveling through my 
horseshoes, the rush of heated air. All of 
it brought forth by the crowd gathered 
upon this land.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Are the races of the Classic Triple Crown 
always this fiercely contested...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. To think the day would come when I 
would run in the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(A future completely unimaginable to my 
younger self...)

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaaaagh!! How dare you say that! How 
dare you, how dare you, how dare you!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... Ugh, no, I must not get angry... 
Still water, still water... Equate raging 
fire with still water...

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Aaaaargh! It's no use!! Aaaaargh, 
this is so frustrating, I'm so pissed off!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG BANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Wait. What did I teach you to do when 
you're feeling frustrated?

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Take that! And that! And that! 
Haaah! So annoying! So annoying! Raaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Channel your anger into your fists. 
Trace the forms and vent it little by 
little."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
As long as we are in the sparring ring, 
throw your fists all you like. Until your 
feelings settle, Yaeno—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Have you calmed down? Now, think. What was 
it that made you angry?

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She's...! ...She's...... but I have to go 
first...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
It seems you understand it yourself. If 
you realize your mistake, correct it. And 
devote yourself to thinking before you get 
angry.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(It took a truly long time... to finally 
quell those raging flames.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(If Grandpa hadn't patiently dealt with 
me, I would have stayed on the wrong 
path.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...How I can repay Grandpa is...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Winning on this prestigious stage and 
proving my growth!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Victory is the only option!!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's dedicate this victory to your 
grandfather!

Yeah, let's dedicate this victory to your 
grandpa!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Ossu!! I am heading out!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki, stepping forth!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You're looking pretty pumped up! Her 
name is... Yaeno Muteki? I wonder if she's 
strong?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Aah, if only that girl had run! She 
totally would've won as the first 
favorite, but having to scratch due to 
injury...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Still, Sakura Chiyono O beat that girl! I 
guess Chiyono O's gotta be the favorite 
after all~.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —*Inhale*... *Exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...Do not be swayed. Focus your mind 
entirely on yourself right now!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: âBEGONE!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Yaeno Muteki really has a unique aura 
about her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"More than just presence, that martial 
arts stance you just did was so sharp and 
cool!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno-san, such incredible 
concentration...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The heat I can feel even from this 
distance... It's swirling inside Yaeno, 
overflowing into sheer pressure...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I have to surpass that heat! I can't 
let my feelings lose!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who's gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san... Chiyono O-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"It's so frustrating... If only I could, I 
wanted to clash fighting spirits right in 
the middle of it all...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...However, right now, it's all for the 
sake of the upcoming Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Allow me to bear witness. To the race 
between you two.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Balance between raging fire and still 
water has been achieved.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The raging fire within me, I shall 
demonstrate my absolute mastery over it!
